experiences.summary: Designed and built an internal alumni-management platform (CRM) for the BYU finance program—centralizing alumni records, tracking engagement, and supporting outreach—built with Next.js, FastAPI, and a Supabase-hosted PostgreSQL database and deployed on Vercel.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Designed and built an internal alumni-management platform (a custom CRM) for the BYU finance program to centralize alumni records, track engagement, and support outreach. The application is deployed on Vercel across separate development and production environments and is used by program staff to manage the alumni database.
I own the full stack: a TypeScript/Next.js frontend, a Python/FastAPI backend, and a Supabase-hosted PostgreSQL database with Supabase Auth for login and role-based access control.

sections.title: What I Built
list: Designed a PostgreSQL schema of ~25 tables (managed with Alembic migrations) covering alumni records, contact info, employment and education history, events and attendance, interactions, follow-up tasks, and an immutable audit log.

Built a FastAPI backend (async SQLAlchemy + asyncpg) exposing CRUD, multi-dimension search and filtering, dashboard aggregations, event management, audit search, and admin endpoints—covered by ~220 passing pytest tests with CI for linting, tests, and secret scanning.

Built the Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind frontend, including an alumni list with search and 10+ filters, profile pages, dashboards with KPIs and charts, and an interactive US map showing alumni distribution down to the county level.
Implemented role-based access control with three roles (super admin, full access, view-only), enforced server-side in the API and reflected in the UI.

Built data-ingestion and cleaning pipelines that normalize and validate incoming alumni data before it is written—standardizing names, parsing and validating emails, phone numbers, and LinkedIn URLs, enforcing the BYU ID format, and checking values against controlled industry, tag, and status vocabularies.

Built a CSV bulk-import pipeline (parse → dry-run validation → commit) that reuses the same cleaning layer, with per-row error reporting and automatic duplicate detection both within an upload and against existing records.
Implemented Supabase Auth login with JWT verification and session management, including idle-timeout handling and cross-tab session awareness.
Set up deployment and CI/CD on Vercel with separate dev and production environments and GitHub Actions checks on pull requests.

sections.title: Technologies Used
paragraphs: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, Python, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth, Postgres, Storage), Alembic, Vercel, GitHub Actions

experiences.summary: Maintain and extend a production-grade investment analytics platform used by student portfolio managers to evaluate performance, analyze time-series data, and support live investment decisions.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: BYU Silver Fund is one of the oldest and largest student-run investment funds in the United States, managed entirely by students across finance, accounting, economics, mathematics, and computer science under faculty supervision in the Marriott School of Business. Students conduct original research, make live investment decisions, and are directly accountable for fund performance. Alumni of the program have gone on to leadership roles across top firms in the finance industry.

As a Full Stack Engineer, I maintain and extend a production-grade investment analytics platform that supports multiple student-managed funds, including an undergraduate fundamental fund, a graduate fundamental fund, and a quantitative fund. The platform is used weekly by portfolio managers and analysts to evaluate performance, analyze time-series data, and support investment decisions.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
list: Maintain and manage four core repositories that collectively power the Silver Fund analytics platform, ensuring reliability, consistency, and clean integration across backend services, data pipelines, and frontend dashboards.

Design and implement backend features using FastAPI and PostgreSQL, including a data download project that enables users to export time-series performance data as CSV files for external analysis and reporting.

Work directly with the production database, writing and optimizing queries and supporting data processing pipelines using Polars to handle portfolio returns, benchmarks, and historical performance data.
Contribute to frontend development by improving UI and UX across dashboards, including interactive charts, tables, filters, and CSV download functionality used by portfolio managers.
Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary engineering team through weekly team meetings, shared planning, and coordinated development cycles to deliver features aligned with fund needs.
Participate in structured Git workflows by reviewing pull requests, providing technical feedback, and submitting PRs to maintain code quality and consistency across the codebase.

sections.title: Frontend & User Experience Contributions
list: Built and enhanced dashboard features such as performance charts, data tables, filtering controls, and CSV export actions.
Improved usability and clarity of investment dashboards to support faster analysis and cleaner presentation of fund performance data.
Customized the AWS Amplify authentication and security interface using CSS to better match the platform’s design and improve the login and account security experience.
Implemented UI updates that aligned frontend behavior with backend data changes and new analytics features.

subsections.title: Platform Redesign Initiative
paragraphs: Leading the redesign of the Silver Fund analytics platform beginning with interface planning and prototyping in Figma, followed by full frontend implementation in TypeScript and React. The redesign focuses on improving usability, visual hierarchy, responsiveness, and clarity across investment dashboards used by portfolio managers and analysts.
list: Redesigned analytics views including performance metrics, benchmark comparisons, holdings displays, and chart layouts to create a cleaner and more intuitive fintech-style user experience.
Translated Figma prototypes into reusable production-ready React and TypeScript components while maintaining compatibility with existing backend APIs and analytics infrastructure.
Improved dashboard consistency through updated spacing systems, responsive layouts, reusable UI patterns, and enhanced data presentation for investment analysis workflows.
